title: House
description: Thermostats, HVAC runs and weather, from the climatectl logger.

target.rawQueryText:
SELECT opened_at AS time, coalesce(resolved_at, last_seen_at) AS timeEnd,
       title || ': ' || message AS text, priority AS tags
FROM alert
WHERE opened_at <= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', $__to / 1000, 'unixepoch') AND coalesce(resolved_at, last_seen_at) >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', $__from / 1000, 'unixepoch')

panels.title: Temperature (${unit:text})
panels.description: Indoor temperature per thermostat, its heat setpoint (dashed, orange) and cool setpoint (dotted, blue), and outdoor temperature. Thermostats report a new reading only when it changes, so indoor lines are drawn as steps.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT r.at AS time, t.name AS level, CASE '${unit}' WHEN 'celsius' THEN r.temp_c ELSE r.temp_c * 9 / 5 + 32 END AS indoor
FROM indoor_reading r JOIN thermostat t USING (device_id)
WHERE r.at >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', $__from / 1000, 'unixepoch', '-6 hours') AND r.at <= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', $__to / 1000, 'unixepoch')
ORDER BY r.at

panels.title: Furnace and AC
panels.description: When each thermostat called for heat (orange) or cooling (blue).

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT s.at AS time, t.name AS level, s.status
FROM hvac_status s JOIN thermostat t USING (device_id)
WHERE s.at >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', $__from / 1000, 'unixepoch', '-6 hours') AND s.at <= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', $__to / 1000, 'unixepoch')
ORDER BY s.at, s.source

panels.title: Daily runtime
panels.description: Minutes of heating and cooling per day and thermostat.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT w.day AS time, t.name AS level,
       coalesce(h.heating_min, 0) AS heating, coalesce(h.cooling_min, 0) AS cooling
FROM weather_daily w
CROSS JOIN thermostat t
LEFT JOIN hvac_daily h ON h.day = w.day AND h.device_id = t.device_id
WHERE w.day >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', $__from / 1000, 'unixepoch', '-1 day') AND w.day <= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', $__to / 1000, 'unixepoch')
ORDER BY w.day, t.name
targets.queryText:
SELECT w.day AS time, t.name AS level,
       coalesce(h.heating_min, 0) AS heating, coalesce(h.cooling_min, 0) AS cooling
FROM weather_daily w
CROSS JOIN thermostat t
LEFT JOIN hvac_daily h ON h.day = w.day AND h.device_id = t.device_id
WHERE w.day >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', $__from / 1000, 'unixepoch', '-1 day') AND w.day <= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', $__to / 1000, 'unixepoch')
ORDER BY w.day, t.name

panels.title: Daily summary
panels.description: Runtime per thermostat next to the day's outdoor temperatures. Heating degree-days (base 65°F, or 18.3°C) measure how cold the day was: over time, runtime per degree-day is the efficiency baseline.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT w.day AS time, t.name AS level,
       coalesce(h.heating_min, 0) AS heating, coalesce(h.cooling_min, 0) AS cooling,
       CASE '${unit}' WHEN 'celsius' THEN w.min_c ELSE w.min_c * 9 / 5 + 32 END AS low, CASE '${unit}' WHEN 'celsius' THEN w.max_c ELSE w.max_c * 9 / 5 + 32 END AS high, w.hdd_f * CASE '${unit}' WHEN 'celsius' THEN 5.0 / 9 ELSE 1 END AS hdd
FROM weather_daily w
CROSS JOIN thermostat t
LEFT JOIN hvac_daily h ON h.day = w.day AND h.device_id = t.device_id
WHERE w.day >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', $__from / 1000, 'unixepoch', '-1 day') AND w.day <= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', $__to / 1000, 'unixepoch')
ORDER BY w.day DESC, t.name
targets.queryText:

FROM weather_daily w
CROSS JOIN thermostat t

ORDER BY w.day DESC, t.name

panels.title: Heating and cooling runs
panels.description: Each finished run: how long it lasted, how far the temperature moved and how fast. A falling rate in similar weather is the first sign of a struggling furnace or AC.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT start_at AS time, name AS level,
       CASE status WHEN 'heating' THEN 'Heat' ELSE 'Cool' END AS mode,
       minutes,
       CASE '${unit}' WHEN 'celsius' THEN start_temp_c ELSE start_temp_c * 9 / 5 + 32 END AS start_temp, CASE '${unit}' WHEN 'celsius' THEN end_temp_c ELSE end_temp_c * 9 / 5 + 32 END AS end_temp,
       (end_temp_c - start_temp_c) * CASE '${unit}' WHEN 'celsius' THEN 1 ELSE 9.0 / 5 END AS change,
       rate_c_per_h * CASE '${unit}' WHEN 'celsius' THEN 1 ELSE 9.0 / 5 END AS rate,
       CASE '${unit}' WHEN 'celsius' THEN outdoor_c ELSE outdoor_c * 9 / 5 + 32 END AS outdoor
FROM hvac_cycle
WHERE start_at >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', $__from / 1000, 'unixepoch') AND start_at <= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', $__to / 1000, 'unixepoch')
ORDER BY start_at DESC

panels.title: Humidity
panels.description: Indoor relative humidity per thermostat, and outdoor.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT s.taken_at AS time, t.name AS level, s.humidity_pct AS indoor
FROM thermostat_snapshot s JOIN thermostat t USING (device_id)
WHERE s.taken_at >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', $__from / 1000, 'unixepoch', '-6 hours') AND s.taken_at <= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', $__to / 1000, 'unixepoch') AND s.humidity_pct IS NOT NULL AND s.online IS NOT 0
ORDER BY s.taken_at
targets.queryText:

ORDER BY s.taken_at

panels.title: Dew point (${unit:text})
panels.description: Water in the air per thermostat, and outdoor. Unlike relative humidity it compares across temperatures: open windows dry the house when the outdoor line is below the indoor ones.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT at AS time, level, CASE '${unit}' WHEN 'celsius' THEN dew_point_c ELSE dew_point_c * 9 / 5 + 32 END AS indoor
FROM dew_point
WHERE level <> 'Outdoor' AND at >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', $__from / 1000, 'unixepoch', '-6 hours') AND at <= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', $__to / 1000, 'unixepoch')
ORDER BY at
